details:
Build Version (1275)

- Vote to kick notifications are not displaying for others in the instance

- If another person votes to kick the same person they get (A vote to kick has already been initiated on this player)

- No one else can see the kick notification in the world/instance

This issue is making it hard to remove users from instances due to no one being able to accept or refuse the kick notification.
